content:
[Intro]
[G#5]We are
beggars We are
so fucking weak And
once upon a time we had the
world at our feet
Well, we're all dying to
meet our maker
But all our
Gods have abandoned us
All our
Gods have abandoned us
This is the great eso-
teric depression
We sold our souls but couldn't
buy salvation

[Verse 1]
[G#5]We are all the shades
of misery
The reigning cham-
pions of tragedy
They use their faith as a wea-
pon They count our sins by the se-
ven Blackwater at the
gates of heaven

[Chorus]
[G#5]All hail
the corpotocracy
The word of God
written in binary
All hail
our apostasy
The dying notes in an
unholy symphony

[Intro Riff]
[G#5]
All our
Gods have abandoned us
This is the great eso-
teric depression
We sold our souls but couldn't
buy salvation

[Verse 2]
[G#m]I found God
clutching a razor blade
[F#]He said look
at the fucking mess they've made
[E5]They'd trade their
hearts if they were made of gold
[C#5]
We are
[G#m]beggars We are
so fucking weak And
[F#]once upon a time we had the
world at our feet Well, we're all
[E5]dying to
meet our maker
[C#5]But all our
Gods have abandoned us

[Break]
[G#5]
All our
Gods have abandoned
us
All our
Gods have abandoned us

[Chorus]
[G#5]I found God
clutching a razor blade
He said look
at the fucking mess they've made
They'd trade their
hearts if they were made of gold
But they're as
worthless as the souls they sold

[Outro]
title: Nihilist
tuning: G# F# B E G# C#
